title_en: Beautiful Places in China (11/20): The Terracotta Army, an Underground Host
note_en: 竟然 (jìngrán) marks something as surprising to the speaker: 没想到竟然挖出了碎陶片 "to everyone's surprise, they dug up shards of pottery." It goes before the verb and adds the feeling of "of all things" or "unexpectedly"; here it even doubles up with 没想到 "never expected" for extra emphasis. The last sentence pairs it with a rhetorical question the same way: 谁能想到…农民竟然为世界打开了… "who could have imagined that farmers would reveal..."
